Editing that test was forbidden, and adding implementation-side global pathlib/test monkeypatches would violate the fixture boundary. Git commit was also refused by the read-only .git index; the launcher commit message is in out/COMMIT_MSG.

commit.body:
Add the production-Python fixture as a packaged JSON-lines records
service with its wire-facing CLI, pinned toolchain configuration,
focused service tests, and local Ruff policy.

Plant the seven declared calibration faults with independently green
fixes, executable red probes, clean neighbours, exact source spans,
and grading metadata in FAULTS.json.
